arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, game sprite adaptation. Create a production game sprite sheet of IONA from the supplied original band reference. Only Iona (the short-black-bowl-cut woman seated at the drum kit) is the identity and costume anchor. Preserve her exact face, tan skin, precise round short black bowl haircut with bangs, small subtle ear piercings, dark charcoal work/stage jacket with small warm brass fasteners and rolled sleeves. Use matching dark practical trousers and flat dark boots. Remove the drum kit and drumsticks: this is her unarmed Nightwalker street gameplay sprite. Same charming detailed pixel-art rendering and chunky proportions as the reference, clean pixels and restrained highlights, not smooth vector art, not a comic page, not painterly. Her expression is focused and determined. No cap, no glasses, no headphones, no long hair, no new tattoos, no armor, no weapons, no other actor.

Deliver a single landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG SPRITE ATLAS, exactly SIX equally spaced columns by FOUR equally spaced rows, each 256x256 cell. EXACTLY 24 separate full-body Iona figures. The sheet has NO text, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO background, NO floor shadow, NO equipment. Every sprite has generous transparent margins, must fit wholly within its own cell, no overlaps or cropped limbs. Character scale constant: standing figures about 195px high. Feet baseline at local y=235, body centered at local x=128. Fixed side-view/three-quarter game camera, faces RIGHT in every pose; no perspective switching. Maintain same head/face/outfit/pixel scale in all cells. Hands must be anatomically clear. Rows left-to-right:
ROW 1: 1 standing ready neutral idle, 2 walk stride left leg forward, 3 walking passing pose, 4 walk stride right leg forward, 5 walking opposite passing pose, 6 airborne jump with knees lifted.
ROW 2: 7 defensive guard both forearms up, 8 straight lead-hand jab fully extended right, 9 rear-hand cross extended right with torso twist, 10 rising uppercut with bent punching arm raised, 11 crouching low punch right, 12 straight waist-high front kick right.
ROW 3: 13 rising high kick right, 14 low sweeping kick right with low bent supporting leg, 15 upward launching knee strike right, 16 airborne straight punch right, 17 airborne side kick right, 18 airborne downward palm strike.
ROW 4: 19 low forward dash lean right, 20 standing two-handed forward grapple reach, 21 forward throw release with open hands reaching right, 22 rising overhead throw release with arms high, 23 recoil hurt pose leaning back to left, 24 downed lying horizontally on her side head LEFT feet RIGHT, entire body still inside cell. The final downed pose is lower and wide but not rescaled relative to other poses.

This is one review candidate for a game asset, no dialogue or narrative events. The band image defines her identity; do not depict drumming in any output cell.
